descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Open wide! Welcome to the only dental clinic that treats kaiju, the funniest VR arcade shooter on the rooftop.

Every giant monster stomps out of the harbour, squeezes into a skyscraper-sized dentist chair and opens its enormous jaws right in front of you.

[media]

SHOOT THE GERMS, NEVER THE FILLINGS
Grab a tool and pop germs, plaque, stubborn rot and sneaky runners in this physics-based target shooter. Chain combos and hit FEVER for double cash. Watch the rage bar: bad breath, chomping jaws and grumpy monsters test your aim.

[media]

SPEND YOUR TIPS
After every shift, Kaiju Mart has 15 roguelite-style upgrades: laughing gas, tip jars, magnifiers, golden guns and party hats for your patients.

[media]

BOSS FIGHTS
VIPs in crowns pay triple, and every fifth day brings a MEGA MOLAR boss. Pull it!

[media]

PLAY YOUR WAY
- Endless score-attack shifts with a new twist every day
- Rush Hour: a 3-minute time attack for high scores
- 30 stickers that boost every future run
- Hall of Smiles photo wall of happy patients
- Casual-friendly: optional laser sight and infinite ammo
- Great for VR beginners, party nights and quick sessions

A funny monster simulator, dentist game and VR shooter in one. Giant patients. Tiny patience. Can you keep them smiling?
